sections.title: Parallel items (report 11.5, 10.3, 16.1 row 8; .claude/spec/loopctl-parallel.md)
comment: OPT-IN and evidence-gated: `parallel_mode: worktree` and `pipeline_host: workflow` refuse until docs/baseline/evidence.json passes.
Read from the BASE sha, never from the branch under judgement (CO-11).

keys.name: parallel_mode
doc: off | worktree   (report 11.5 item 3, DEC-9). EXPERIMENTAL. `worktree` lets the driver (`runner: driver`) build up to max_parallel items at
once, each in its own git worktree under .claude/worktrees/, then integrate them one at a time (rebase, re-run verify, merge). Items run together
only when their dependencies are merged and their `touches.paths` are disjoint; migrations and dependency changes always run alone (schema mutex).
Refuses to enable until the evidence gate passes. off = one item at a time, as in 4c.
keep one item at a time until the evidence gate has passed

keys.name: max_parallel
doc: How many items the driver builds at once when parallel_mode is worktree (1 to 4; the default is the report's 2). Every child gets the remaining
budget divided by the children running (DEC-34), so more workers means a smaller allowance per child, not a larger bill.

keys.name: pipeline_host
doc: conductor | workflow   (report 11.2). Where reviews and critiques fan out. `conductor` = sequential Agent calls from the conductor (the only host
that exists). `workflow` is DESIGN-ONLY (.claude/spec/pipeline-host-workflow.md; probes V3 and V23): the doctor reports it as an error.

keys.name: lease_ttl_s
doc: Seconds a worker, mutex or integration lease may go without a heartbeat before it can be reclaimed (only when its owner process is also gone).
The driver renews them on every poll, so this only matters after a crash.
